items.source: Receive last notification of a logical AND predicate.
items.translation: 接收逻辑与谓词的最后一个通知。

items.source: Receive last notification of a negated predicate.
items.translation: 接收否定谓词的最后一个通知。

items.source: Receive last notification of a logical OR predicate.
items.translation: 接收逻辑或谓词的最后一个通知。

items.source: Receive notification of an HTTP header predicate.
items.translation: 接收 HTTP 头谓词的通知。

items.source: Receive notification of an HTTP method predicate.
items.translation: 接收 HTTP 方法谓词的通知。

items.source: Receive notification of a parameter predicate.
items.translation: 接收参数谓词的通知。

items.source: Receive notification of a path predicate.
items.translation: 接收路径谓词的通知。

items.source: Receive first notification of an unknown predicate.
items.translation: 接收未知谓词的首次通知。
接收逻辑与谓词的首个通知。随后的首个通知将包含 AND 谓词的左侧；接着是and()，然后是右侧，最后是endAnd()。

items.source: Receive "middle" notification of a logical AND predicate. The following notification contains the right-hand side, followed by endAnd().
items.translation: 接收逻辑与谓词的“中间”通知。 以下通知包含右侧部分，后跟endAnd()。
接收逻辑 OR 谓词的首条通知。随后的第一条通知将包含 OR 谓词的左侧；第二条通知包含右侧，后跟endOr()。

items.source: Receive "middle" notification of a logical OR predicate. The following notification contains the right-hand side, followed by endOr().
items.translation: 接收逻辑 OR 谓词的“中间”通知。 以下通知包含右侧部分，后跟 endOr()。

items.source: Receive first notification of a negated predicate. The first subsequent notification will contain the negated predicated, followed by endNegate().
items.translation: 接收否定谓词的首条通知。随后的第一条通知将包含该否定谓词，后跟 endNegate()。

items.source: without replacement to discourage use of path extensions for request mapping and for content negotiation (with similar deprecations and removals already applied to annotated controllers). For further context, please read issue #24179
items.translation: 不带替换以 discouraging 使用路径扩展进行请求映射和内容协商（已对注解控制器应用了类似的弃用和移除）。有关更多背景信息，请阅读问题#24179。 *注：原文中 "discourage use" 为动词短语，直译为“阻止使用”或“劝阻使用”。在技术文档语境下，通常指通过 API 变更来引导开发者避免某种做法。此处保留原意进行翻译。*

items.source:
without replacement to discourage use of path extensions for request
mapping and for content negotiation (with similar deprecations and removals already
applied to annotated controllers).
items.translation:
不带替换，以 discouraging 使用路径扩展进行请求映射和内容协商（已对注解控制器应用了类似的弃用和移除）。

*Correction based on strict translation rules (no English words):*
不带替换，以阻止使用路径扩展进行请求映射和内容协商（已对注解控制器应用了类似的弃用和移除）。

items.source: Receives notifications from the logical structure of request predicates.
items.translation: 接收请求谓词逻辑结构的通知。

items.source: Receive "middle" notification of a logical AND predicate.
items.translation: 接收逻辑与谓词的“中间”通知。

items.source: Receive "middle" notification of a logical OR predicate.
items.translation: 接收逻辑 OR 谓词的“中间”通知。

items.source: Receive first notification of a logical AND predicate.
items.translation: 接收逻辑与谓词的首次通知。

items.source: Receive first notification of a negated predicate.
items.translation: 接收否定谓词的首次通知。

items.source: Receive first notification of a logical OR predicate.
items.translation: 接收逻辑 OR 谓词的首次通知。

items.source: Receive notification of an API version predicate.
items.translation: 接收 API 版本谓词的通知。

items.source: Receive notification of a path extension predicate.
items.translation: 接收路径扩展谓词的通知。

items.source:
Receive notification of an API version predicate. The version could
be fixed ("1.2") or baseline ("1.2+").
items.translation: 接收 API 版本谓词的通知。该版本可以是固定的（"1.2"）或基线（"1.2+"）。

items.source: methods - the HTTP methods that make up the predicate
items.translation: methods - 构成谓词的 HTTP 方法

items.source: pattern - the path pattern that makes up the predicate
items.translation: pattern - 构成谓词的路径模式

items.source: extension - the path extension that makes up the predicate
items.translation: extension - 构成谓词的路径扩展名

items.source: name - the name of the HTTP header to check
items.translation: name - 要检查的 HTTP 头名称

items.source: value - the desired value of the HTTP header
items.translation: value - HTTP 标头的期望值

items.source: name - the name of the parameter
items.translation: name - 参数的名称

items.source: value - the desired value of the parameter
items.translation: value - 参数的期望值

items.source: version - the configured version
items.translation: version - 配置的版本
